第十五章 洞内惨战
郭飞的耳朵异常的灵敏，自然也听到了。他摆摆手，示意几人退后，并朝山洞后面唯一一个凸出的石头后面指了指，示意六人藏在凸出石头一侧。
几人刚藏好，外面弓箭手攻了进来，先是猛放一阵箭，然后投入了两个火把，火把照亮了整个洞穴，但几人趴在地上，藏在阴暗处，他们一时没有发现。
“兄弟们，他们没几人，冲进去杀了他们，夺魂晶！”刀疤厉喝一声，小洞口一闪，几个人迅速的冲了进来。
郭飞将身体贴着洞口右侧洞壁的阴暗处，几个兵丁一手举着火把，一手握着一个匕首冲了进来，后面有人举着箭支跟随警戒，他们举着火把，火把照亮了他们眼睛，加上洞内比外面阴暗，一时看不到里面情况，凑在一起往前摸索。
“十个、十五、二十、三十……。”郭飞暗自数数，同时将剑兵离体，转换为忍者，准备发出火球球后逃离。
郭飞心中没底，毕竟这个火球能不能放出去，老九说的对不对，都是未知数，一旦失误，只能迅速的躲避箭支。
“哧！”郭飞扬手将团成一团的火球符甩了出去，火球符窜入冲进来的弓兵人群的时候，郭飞暗自叫了一声“爆”。
“轰！”一团剧烈的火球团瞬间在人群中爆裂开来，处在火球爆裂范围的几人瞬间毙命，火花飞舞，将附近几人身体上的衣服点燃，他们顿时乱作一团。在洞口处相互挤压逃命。
“杀！”金大通厉喝一声，眼睛通红，杀了上来。其余人也跟着冲了上来，此时就是搏命的时候，不是你死就是我亡。
郭飞没有用玄铁剑，而是从地上将弓箭手的短匕首捡了起来，身影晃动，展开忍者身法，在慌乱的人群中闪动穿梭，手中匕首划过他们的脖颈，喷出道道血箭。
这是一场残酷的面对面的厮杀，金大通等人呈半弧形围拢了过来，朝着慌乱的弓箭手掩杀，残肢断臂血肉乱飞。尤其是金大通，双眼通红，拼了命，大剑翻滚，左右掩杀，丝毫不防御，魁梧的身体上留下了弓箭手临死反击的道道伤痕。
这些弓箭手并不是软柿子，而是久经杀伐的战士，在军营中属于兵痞一类的，战力不错。要不然也不敢明目张胆的抢劫，尤其是哪个“刀疤”，显然是久经战事，指挥调度有方，在其嗷嗷怪叫下，其手下竟然没有临阵退缩的，可见此人是个狠人。
在火球烧死几人，熄灭后，外面的弓箭手渐渐的占据了上风，叫嚣着冲了进来。和几人展开了厮杀，毕竟他们人多势众，渐渐的压下了几人。
“啊！”老六中箭倒地，几人拖着他被逼退后，举着火把的弓箭兵冲了进来。将黑洞洞的山洞照亮，郭飞等人这一次一下子暴露在亮光下。
“呵呵。就你们几人，还想逃出本大爷的手掌。”一个人说着话缓缓的从洞口处闪出，只见此人脸上一个长长、狰狞的刀疤，一脸的凶相。
其余人停止了战斗，闪出了路道，一个个冰冷的箭支指向郭飞等人。
待宰的羔羊，死前要戏弄一番，正是这些兵痞一贯取乐的方式。
“刀疤！”金大通双眼通红，恶狠狠道。
“呵呵，金老大，上次没有杀了你，今天补上。看今天还有你们营长给你撑腰不？”刀疤仰天大笑。

“死！”郭飞等的就是这个时刻，手掌一挥，短剑化作一道流光窜了出去。
这一刻瞬间成了永恒，刀疤笑声未断，一柄短匕首已经插在了他的咽喉处，满嘴的血沫从嘴中翻出，手指指着郭飞痛苦的捂住了脖颈，不甘的倒了下去。
“忍者的飞刀攻击，果然实用！”郭飞心中暗忖，这还不是专用的飞镖，而是短匕首。在短匕首出手的瞬间，郭飞有种“掌控感”，在这么短的距离内，他确定能指哪射哪，刀疤必死无疑。
虽然有器感，但依然有点生涩，郭飞觉得，佩戴专用的飞镖、飞刀，多加练习后，将会是自己出其不意攻其无备的杀手锏。
“爆”在刀疤倒地同时，趁着众人惊愕的瞬间，金大通掏出火球符，将身上的血迹涂抹上面，瞬间脱手而出，朝虎视眈眈的弓箭手射去，火球符爆裂开来，发出了剧烈的声响，爆出了一团火球，将刀疤附近的弓箭兵笼罩了起来，一阵焦糊的臭味传来，四五人倒在了火球中。
“杀！”金大通厉声大喝，又一轮的残酷厮杀面对面的展开。
“哧！”郭飞手中握着一个箭支，诡异的转身飞驰，将其插入一个弓箭兵的太阳穴中，此人仰身翻倒。
顿时，体内冷冽的气流顿时一涨，身体瞬间充满了力量。忍者升级了。
没有了刀疤，没有人督阵，这些人士气大落，谁愿意为身外之物拼命呢？面对这么几个不要命的人，他们仓皇败退。
激战结束，几人都满身血污，坐在了山洞的墙角，悲伤和疲劳让几人沉默不语。
郭飞将弯刀虚影纳入兵符空间中，发现一个很奇怪的现象，弯刀虚影上面闪现的不是白色的光芒，而是黑色，如同黑珍珠一样的黑色的光芒将虚影占据了一小段，表明是二级忍者。这让郭飞非常的疑惑和不解。
虽然击退了弓箭中队，但每个人都心中异常的苦涩，老二、老三、老四和老六都失去了生命，成为冰冷的尸体了。
“老大，节哀顺变吧！”郭飞拍了拍金大通的肩膀，劝慰道。
老九从衣袋中掏出了一种黑色的粉末，这是兵营发放的，这种粉末可以让尸体燃烧起来，不至于被鬼族得到尸体炼成鬼兵。
粉末洒在几人的尸体上，火捻点起，四人的尸体瞬间爆起火光，熊熊的烈火燃烧，火舌吞噬了四人。映照在郭飞等人的脸上，这一次，几人眼中似乎都很平静。
郭飞在这一刻似乎彻底的融入了这个世界，残酷的世界，必须有颗坚强的心。人命如草芥，如果要想获得别人的尊重，就要有相应的身份地位，有惊人的修为，人不犯我我不犯人，人若犯我，我必杀之。这才是自己应该追寻的道路。
“老十，你带着几位兄弟回去，我不想你们冒险。”金大通将老二的骨灰收集在装火球符的布袋中，淡淡的朝郭飞等人道。
“你呢，老大！”老九轻声道。
“我有妻儿，为了她们的幸福，只能冒险，你们不同，还年轻，以后有大把的机会，回去吧。”金大通说完，身影一闪，背起宝剑，走出山洞，大步而去。萧索的身影、坚定的步伐渐渐的消散在众人的眼中。
众人没有劝说金大通，也没有跟随他，他的性格就如同犟牛，大家知道劝说也没有用。特别是从小一起长大老二的身亡，他觉得内疚，这个心结别人打不开，只有他自己去消化。

他渴望尽快的回到家乡，将老二的骨灰送回去，所以他要去冒险夺取魂晶，但以他的性格，绝不会让人跟随了，再连累别人。
而且，除了郭飞外，其余人也不想前进了。为财搏命，没有勇气的人是不愿意干的。
“老十，你怎么打算，我们要回去了！”老九看郭飞怔怔的看着迷雾出神，过来低声道。
“你们先回！”郭飞一摆手，轻声道。
“小心！”老九低声说了一句，追上其余默默返回的几人，原路返回。
郭飞刚才陷入沉思，是因为他发现，尸兵杨营长可以出棺了。

content_en:
Chapter 15 The brutal battle in the cave
Guo Fei's ears were extremely sensitive, so he naturally heard it. He waved his hand to signal the others to step back, and pointed behind the only protruding stone at the back of the cave, indicating that the six of them should hide on the side of the protruding stone.
As soon as the few people hid, the archers from outside attacked. First they fired a burst of arrows, and then threw in two torches. The torches illuminated the entire cave, but several people lay on the ground and hid in the darkness. They were not noticed for a while.
"Brothers, there aren't many of them, rush in and kill them with the soul-stealing crystal!" Scar shouted sharply, the small hole flashed, and several people rushed in quickly.
Guo Fei pressed his body against the darkness of the cave wall on the right side of the cave entrance. Several soldiers rushed in holding a torch in one hand and a dagger in the other. There were people behind them holding arrows and following the warning. They held the torches, and the torches illuminated their eyes. In addition, the cave was darker than the outside, so they could not see what was going on inside for a while, so they gathered together and groped forward.
"Ten, fifteen, twenty, thirty..." Guo Fei counted secretly, and at the same time, he separated his sword soldiers from his body and transformed into a ninja, preparing to fire a fireball and escape.
Guo Fei was unsure. After all, it was unknown whether the fireball could be released or whether Lao Jiu was right. If he made a mistake, he could only quickly dodge the arrow.
"Chi!" Guo Fei raised his hand and threw out the ball of fireball talisman. When the fireball talisman rushed into the crowd of archers who rushed in, Guo Fei secretly shouted "explosion".
"Boom!" A violent fireball exploded in the crowd instantly. Several people in the explosion range of the fireball were killed instantly. Sparks flew and ignited the clothes on the bodies of several people nearby. They were immediately thrown into chaos. They squeezed each other at the entrance of the cave to escape.
"Kill!" Jin Datong shouted sharply, his eyes were red, and he came to kill. The rest of the people also rushed forward. This was the time to fight for their lives. Either you died or I died.
Guo Fei did not use the black iron sword, but picked up the archer's short dagger from the ground. His figure swayed, and he unfolded his ninja skills, flashing through the panicked crowd. The dagger in his hand swiped across their necks, spurting out blood arrows.
This was a cruel face-to-face fight. Jin Datong and others surrounded them in a semi-arc shape and attacked the panicked archers. Their limbs, broken arms, and flesh were flying everywhere. Especially Jin Datong, his eyes were red, he was fighting for his life, his sword was rolling, he was killing from left and right, without any defense, his burly body was left with scars from the archers' dying counterattacks.
These archers are not soft persimmons, but warriors who have been killed for a long time. They are classified as ruffians in the military camp and have good combat capabilities. Otherwise, they would not dare to blatantly rob, especially the "Scar", who was obviously experienced in battles and had good command and control. Despite his strange screams, his subordinates did not shrink from the battle, which shows that this person is a ruthless person.
After the fireball burned several people to death and was extinguished, the archers outside gradually gained the upper hand and rushed in with a roar. He started fighting with several people. After all, they were outnumbered and gradually suppressed several people.
"Ah!" Lao Liu fell to the ground after being hit by an arrow. Several people dragged him back and forced him to retreat. Archers holding torches rushed in. Illuminating the dark cave, Guo Fei and others were suddenly exposed to bright light this time.
"Haha. You are the only ones who want to escape from my uncle's grasp." A man slowly emerged from the hole as he spoke. He saw a long, ferocious scar on his face and a fierce look on his face.
The others stopped fighting and stepped out of the way, pointing cold arrows at Guo Fei and others.
The lambs waiting to be slaughtered were teased before they died, which was how these soldiers always had fun.
"Scar!" Jin Datong's eyes were red and he said fiercely.
"Haha, Boss Jin, I didn't kill you last time, so I will make up for it today. Do you still have your battalion commander to support you today?" Scar looked up to the sky and laughed.
"Death!" Guo Fei was waiting for this moment. With a wave of his hand, the dagger turned into a stream of light.Ran out.
This moment instantly became an eternity. Scar's laughter didn't stop, but a short dagger was inserted into his throat. A mouth full of blood foam came out of his mouth. He pointed at Guo Fei and covered his neck in pain, and fell down unwillingly.
"The ninja's flying knife attack is really practical!" Guo Fei thought to himself, this is not a special throwing dart, but a short dagger. At the moment when the dagger was shot, Guo Fei had a "sense of control". In such a short distance, he was sure to shoot wherever he could, and Scar would definitely die.
Although it feels like a weapon, it is still a bit unfamiliar. Guo Fei feels that wearing special darts and throwing knives, and practicing more, will be his trump card to catch unprepared people by surprise.
"Explosion" At the same time that Scar fell to the ground, while everyone was stunned, Jin Datong took out the fireball talisman, smeared the blood on his body, and shot it out at the eyeing archers. The fireball talisman exploded with a violent sound, and a ball of fire exploded, covering the archers near Scar. A burning smell came, and four or five people fell into the fireball.
"Kill!" Jin Datong shouted sharply, and another round of brutal fighting began face to face.
"Chi!" Guo Fei held an arrow in his hand. He turned around and flew strangely, inserting it into the temple of an archer. The man fell over on his back.
Suddenly, the cold air flow inside the body suddenly surged, and the body was instantly filled with strength. Ninja leveled up.
Without Scar and no one to supervise the formation, the morale of these people has been greatly reduced. Who is willing to fight for the things outside themselves? Facing such a few people who were desperate for their lives, they retreated hastily.
After the fierce battle, several people were covered in blood and sat in the corner of the cave. Sadness and fatigue made several people silent.
Guo Fei incorporated the scimitar shadow into the talisman space and discovered a very strange phenomenon. What flashed on the scimitar shadow was not white light, but black. The black light like a black pearl occupied a small section of the shadow, indicating that it was a second-level ninja. This made Guo Fei very confused and puzzled.
Although the bow and arrow squadron was repelled, everyone felt extremely bitter in their hearts. The second, third, fourth and sixth children all lost their lives and became cold corpses.
"Boss, please forgive me and accept the change!" Guo Fei patted Jin Datong on the shoulder and comforted him.
Lao Jiu took out a black powder from his pocket, which was distributed by the barracks. This powder can make the corpse burn and prevent the ghost clan from getting the corpse and turning it into a ghost soldier.
The powder was sprinkled on the corpses of several people, and the fire was ignited. The corpses of the four people instantly burst into flames. The raging fire burned, and the tongues of fire devoured the four people. Reflected on the faces of Guo Fei and others, this time, their eyes seemed to be calm.
Guo Fei seemed to have completely integrated into this world at this moment. In a cruel world, one must have a strong heart. Human life is like a piece of grass. If you want to gain the respect of others, you must have a corresponding status and amazing cultivation. I will not offend others unless they offend me. If someone offends me, I will kill them. This is the path you should pursue.
"Lao Shi, you take a few brothers back. I don't want you to take risks." Jin Datong collected Lao Er's ashes in the bag containing the fireball charm and said calmly to Guo Fei and others.
"What about you, boss!" Lao Jiu said softly.
"I have a wife and children. For their happiness, I can only take risks. You are different. You are still young. You will have a lot of opportunities in the future. Go back." After Jin Datong finished speaking, his figure flashed, he picked up the sword, walked out of the cave, and strode away. The desolate figure and firm steps gradually disappeared in everyone's eyes.
No one persuaded Jin Datong, nor did they follow him. His character was like a stubborn bull, and everyone knew that persuasion was useless. Especially when the second child he grew up with died, he felt guilty. No one else could break this knot, so he had to digest it himself.
He is eager to return to his hometown as soon as possible and send his second son's ashes back, so he is going to take the risk to captureSoul Crystal, but with his character, he will never let others follow him and harm others again.
Moreover, except for Guo Fei, the others did not want to move forward. People who have no courage are not willing to fight for money.
"Lao Shi, what are your plans? We are going back!" Lao Jiu saw Guo Fei staring blankly at the mist, and came over and whispered.
"You guys go back first!" Guo Fei waved his hand and said softly.
"Be careful!" Lao Jiu whispered, catching up with the other people who returned silently, and returned the same way.
Guo Fei fell into deep thought just now because he discovered that Corpse Soldier Yang Battalion Commander could be released from the coffin.
